# ATOF

> Open-source graph optimization interface designed for low-friction human and AI use.

## Start here

- atof ai — stable AI capability manifest
- atof doctor — current environment/backend availability
- atof solve <graph> — shortest portfolio solve path
- atof profile <graph> --compact — low-token graph summary
- atof optimize <graph> --engine portfolio --compact — detailed compact result
- AGENTS.md — agent operating rules
- docs/ai-quickstart.md — AI-first interface contract
- docs/claims.md — evidence-backed product claims
- docs/product-quickstart.md — product usage
- docs/open-source-access-benchmark.md — access benchmark protocol
- schemas/atof-ai-v1.schema.json — AI manifest schema
- schemas/atof-doctor-v1.schema.json — environment report schema

## Semantics

ATOF currently exposes balanced, unweighted two-way partitioning. Portfolio selection is empirical on available backends; it is not a universal optimality claim.
